scenario.irule: when GTP_SIGNALLING_INGRESS { set ::version [GTP::header version]; set ::type [GTP::header type]; set ::teid [GTP::header teid]; set ::sequence [GTP::header sequence]; set ::npdu [GTP::header npdu]; set ::length [GTP::length]; set ::message [GTP::message]; set ::payload [GTP::payload]; set ::cause [GTP::ie get value cause:0]; set ::count [GTP::ie count -type cause]; set ::list [GTP::ie get list -type cause]; set ::exists [GTP::ie exists cause:0]; set ::clone [GTP::clone]; GTP::parse $::message; GTP::new 2 32; GTP::header sequence set 12; GTP::header npdu set 9; GTP::forward $::message; GTP::respond $::message; log local0. "v=$::version type=$::type teid=$::teid seq=[GTP::header sequence] npdu=[GTP::header npdu] len=$::length cause=$::cause count=$::count list=$::list exists=$::exists payload=$::payload" }

when GTP_GPDU_INGRESS { set ::prefix [GTP::payload 4]; set ::tunnel [list [GTP::tunnel is_ip] [GTP::tunnel ip_version] [GTP::tunnel ip_proto] [GTP::tunnel ip_src] [GTP::tunnel ip_dst] [GTP::tunnel tcp_src_port] [GTP::tunnel tcp_dst_port]]; set ::replacement [expr {$::tunnel eq "1 4 6 192.0.2.1 198.51.100.2 1234 5678" ? "TEST" : "FAIL"}]; GTP::payload replace 0 4 $::replacement; GTP::discard; log local0. "prefix=$::prefix tunnel=$::tunnel payload=[GTP::payload]" }
